channels.name: Name
channels.cloudNote: This service is operated by a third party: what you send leaves your network. By default, messages from private conversations are not included.
channels.lanWarning: Only tick this if the destination is yours (a server on your LAN or this machine). It lets Meshloom reach private addresses.
channels.verifyTlsHelp: Untick only for a server with a self-signed certificate you trust.
